name: DeviceHistoryOut
description: DeviceHistoryOut schema from Roku Nabu Cloud

creator_id.title: Creator Id
creator_id.description: The ID of the user who started the device.

creator_username.title: Creator Username
creator_username.description: The username of the user who started the device.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: Runtime of the device in seconds.

snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id
snapshot_id.description: The ID of the snapshot to use for the device.

region_id.title: Region Id
region_id.description: The ID of the region where the device will run.

stream_option_id.title: Stream Option Id
stream_option_id.description: The ID of the stream option to use for the device.

max_runtime.title: Max Runtime
max_runtime.description: The maximum runtime of the device in seconds, 0 for project max runtime.

rootfs_artifactory_path.title: Rootfs Artifactory Path
rootfs_artifactory_path.description: The path of the rootfs image in artifactory.

reboot.title: Reboot
reboot.description: Device reboot behaviour.-1 for no reboots, including requested reboot; 0 for no device crash reboots; and >0 for n number of device crash reboots.A device crash is determined by restart_reason in the device nvram. A device shutdown will act like a reboot.
